text: when bringing into view an aim or connection in the graph view, build a proper "camera path".
description:
API for camera path: 
fromRect
toRect

Then it calculates a path. 
At the middle (p=0.5) the bounding box of fromRect and toRect should be the target. 
So we have 3 points. start, overview, end. 
and we have pan and zoom. 

Once the path is ready, move ease out along it.
reflection: Explicit graph focus now follows a three-keyframe camera path: current viewport, a fitted overview of the union of current and destination rectangles at p=0.5, then the fitted aim/connection destination. Node zoom caps and connection fitting remain intact; tracking/manual camera logic is unchanged. Added pure rectangle fitting/union helpers and midpoint regression coverage. Also corrected a GraphSidePanel test double to return the complete aim contract, eliminating its delayed recalculation exception. Verification: map tests 3/3, complete frontend suite 192/192, frontend production build/type-check, and git diff --check passed. Runtime visual review remains because no server was running and it was not started.

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; needs interaction review in the graph UI. Existing frontend runtime was not available, and repository instructions prohibit starting it without an explicit request.
